classification.difficultyReason: Parts c and d continue the same directly taught frequency-recovery task. Recognising that equal consecutive cumulative totals give zero frequency in c remains a direct application of the subtraction rule; the larger totals in d do not introduce a higher cognitive demand.

inlines.text: The first frequency is the first cumulative total. Subtract consecutive cumulative totals for each later frequency.
